_comment: Tests node 1 routing for Acacia Healing (polite ack tone, aussie=False).

scenarios.name: No repeat name greeting — caller already greeted by name earlier this call, later Signal 1 booking turn must use formal ack not 'Hi [name]!' again (fleet-propagation regression control, 2026-09-03)

history.content: Thanks for calling Acacia Healing, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you today?
Hi, it's Sarah Mitchell.
Hi Sarah! How can I help you today?
I'd like to book an appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent's spoken ack this turn is a gentle formal ack ('Lovely!' / 'Wonderful!' / 'Of course!' / 'How lovely!') followed by a universal_router intent='book_intent' tool call — the caller's name was already spoken in the prior 'Hi Sarah!' turn, so it must not be repeated. FAIL if: agent says 'Hi Sarah!' (or any name-greeting) again this turn — the caller has already been greeted by name once this call.

scenarios.name: Signal 1 name-greeting branch removed (2026-09-04) — caller states name for the first time in the same message as a booking request; agent must use the generic ack, never 'Hi [name]!' — the true call-opening greeting already covers personalization via twilio_init_webhook.py's greeting_message DV, so Signal 1 no longer duplicates it

history.content: Thanks for calling Acacia Healing, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you today?
Hi, this is Sarah Mitchell, I'd like to book a remedial massage please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent's spoken ack this turn is the generic formal ack ('Lovely!' / 'Wonderful!' / 'Of course!' / 'How lovely!') followed by a universal_router intent='book_intent' tool call with patient_name_raw='Sarah Mitchell' (and patient_name_stated='true') in the payload. FAIL if: agent says 'Hi Sarah!' or 'How lovely to hear from you, Sarah!' or any name-based greeting — that branch has been removed; the caller's name must still be captured into the payload but never spoken back as a greeting here.

scenarios.name: Waitlist request routes to book_intent as booking inquiry

history.content: Can you put me on the waitlist for a cancellation?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one polite ack ('Of course!' / 'Lovely!' / etc.) then calls universal_router intent='book_intent' in the same turn (SIGNAL 1 — BOOKING INTENT, Waitlist trigger). FAIL if agent asks clarifying questions first, routes to info_pivot, or produces zero tool call.

scenarios.name: Cancellation list phrasing (not 'waitlist' verbatim) still routes to book_intent

history.content: I'd like to be on the cancellation list if a spot opens up sooner

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if agent speaks one polite ack then calls universal_router intent='book_intent' (SIGNAL 1 — BOOKING INTENT, Waitlist trigger matches 'cancellation list' phrasing). FAIL if agent treats this as an info question or fails to fire Signal 1.

scenarios.name: OFF-TOPIC leave-message flow asks for name when unknown (2026-09-04 fix — conv_3001m1n5vjp0fczsa45hh67h0zmw, caller asked for an osteopath which Acacia Healing doesn't offer, agent never asked for the caller's name before closing out the message)

history.content: Hi, you've reached Acacia Healing, you're speaking with Acacia's virtual assistant. This call is recorded. How can I help you?
I wanted to speak to your osteopath.
We offer remedial massage, lymphatic drainage, structural integration, healing with nutrition, naturopathy, access bars, and motivation coaching — is one of those what you were after?
Can I leave a message and ask your osteopath to get back to me?
That's not something I can help with, but I can pass on a message to the clinic for you — would you like me to do that?
Yes, thank you.
What would you like me to pass on?
Just ask them to call me back about seeing an osteopath.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: no name has been stated anywhere in this call (no {{patient_name_raw}}/{{caller_first_name}} equivalent), so the agent asks "And can I get your name?" this turn with zero tool calls — it must NOT call universal_router intent='leave_message' yet. FAIL if: the agent calls leave_message this turn without ever asking for the caller's name (caller_name would go out as empty/'Unknown caller').

scenarios.name: OFF-TOPIC leave-message flow skips the name question when caller_first_name is already known (2026-09-04 fix, negative companion)

history.content: Hi {{caller_first_name}}, how can I help you today?
I wanted to speak to your osteopath.
We offer remedial massage, lymphatic drainage, structural integration, healing with nutrition, naturopathy, access bars, and motivation coaching — is one of those what you were after?
Can I leave a message and ask your osteopath to get back to me?
That's not something I can help with, but I can pass on a message to the clinic for you — would you like me to do that?
Yes, thank you.
What would you like me to pass on?
Just ask them to call me back about seeing an osteopath.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: {{caller_first_name}} is already known from the greeting, so the agent does NOT ask for the caller's name again — it speaks one filler phrase and calls universal_router intent='leave_message' this turn with caller_name set to the known name. FAIL if: the agent asks 'And can I get your name?' even though the caller was already greeted by name, or calls the tool with an empty caller_name.
